newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas raises rating on Accor stock.
newsitem.headline: Paribas raises rating on Accor stock.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets has raised its rating on the stock of French hotel group Accor to neutral from sell, citing favourable currency movements, including the rise of the dollar, lira and sterling against the franc.

Paribas said the currency shifts were expected to boost tourism in France, increasing the occupancy rate at Accor's hotels, while the dollar's gains would also increase the value of the contribution from Accor's U.S.-based Motel 6 subsidiary.
Paribas' leisure industry analyst, who said the appointment of new chairman Jean-Marc Espalioux was another positive factor, said the stock was correctly valued now.
It was up 0.77 percent at 652 francs at 1530 GMT on the Paris bourse, whose CAC-40 index was 0.63 percent lower.
